name: Signuply AI Chat
author: signuply

sections.description:
Businesses lose potential customers every day because website visitors don’t get an instant response. Contact forms are slow, emails are delayed, and many visitors leave before anyone follows up.

Signuply Chat adds an AI assistant to your WordPress site that responds to visitors immediately — even outside business hours. It answers questions, asks qualifying questions, collects contact details, and detects when a lead is ready for follow-up.

Note: This plugin requires a Signuply account to function.

How it works:

  1. Install the plugin and create an account (or connect an existing one) — no coding required.
  2. Configure your assistant: set your goals, qualifying questions, and system prompt using the Signuply dashboard.
  3. Visitors get instant answers and guided conversations around the clock.
  4. See conversations, detected leads, hot opportunities, and contact details all in one place.

Features:

  • Respond to visitors immediately, 24/7 — even after hours.
  • Classify leads as cold, warm, or hot based on intent and conversation signals.
  • Capture email, phone number, or name naturally during the chat.
  • Use website pages and files as context for more accurate, business-specific answers.
  • AI-generated conversation summaries highlight what matters.
  • Trigger email, SMS, or webhook actions when a hot lead is detected.
  • Run separate assistants across multiple sites (Business plan).
  • Track conversations, detected leads, and activity over time.

Your team spends time only on conversations with real potential — not reviewing dozens of generic chats.

Plugin features:

  • Create or connect a Signuply account directly from WordPress.
  • Dual-key security: public key (wgt_) for the widget, private key (wsk_) for settings — never exposed in page source.
  • Sync widget appearance with the Signuply dashboard (title, color, position, welcome message, avatar, privacy policy URL).
  • Local display rules: show/hide the widget on specific pages or filter by device type.
  • Clean uninstall removes all stored data.

Learn more at signuply.io/chat.

External Services

This plugin connects to the external Signuply service to provide AI chat functionality.

Service URL:
https://chat-app.signuply.io

The plugin sends the following data:
– Website URL
– Chat configuration settings
– End-user messages submitted through the chat widget

This data is used to:
– Generate AI responses
– Detect and qualify leads
– Provide conversation history and analytics

Terms of Service:
https://signuply.io/legal/terms

Privacy Policy:
https://signuply.io/legal/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the signuply-chat folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install directly from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Follow the onboarding wizard: create a new Signuply account or connect an existing one with your public (wgt_) and private (wsk_) keys.
  4. Configure your AI assistant in the Signuply dashboard.
  5. Adjust widget appearance and display rules from the plugin settings page.

No coding required — just activate and go.
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI API key?

The Free plan includes a limited number of conversations. After reaching this limit, you can provide your own OpenAI key, which is used via Signuply services. Standard and Business plans include conversations without a separate key.

What is the difference between wgt_ and wsk_ keys?

The wgt_ key is your public widget key — it loads the chat widget on your site. The wsk_ key is your private key — it stays on the server and is used to manage widget settings via the API. The private key is never exposed to visitors.

Can the assistant use my website content for answers?

Yes. In higher plans, your AI assistant can use selected website pages and files as context to answer visitors more accurately — FAQs, service pages, pricing details, and more.

Can I use it on multiple websites?

The Business plan supports multiple websites with separate assistants for each.

What happens when a hot lead is detected?

Signuply can trigger email, SMS, or webhook actions automatically when a high-intent conversation is detected.

Is professional setup available?

Yes. Add professional setup to any plan for +$99. The Signuply team will configure everything for you within 48 hours.
